summary_en: Forside completed acquisition of all shares in Makaluru Digital Co., Ltd. on October 1, 2026, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary. The target company develops and sells website-related software and provides hosting services, with sales of approximately 142 million yen in the fiscal year ended July 2025.
title_en: (Progress Report) Notice Regarding Completion of Share Acquisition (Wholly-Owned Subsidiary)
translation_en_brief:
Forside Co., Ltd. completed the acquisition of all shares in Makaluru Digital Co., Ltd. on October 1, 2026, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary. The company had previously announced this acquisition in a notice dated September 4, 2026. Makaluru Digital, established in August 2012 and headquartered in Tokyo's Setagaya ward, develops and sells website-related software, provides website planning and management services, and operates hosting services. As of the fiscal year ended July 2025, the company had sales of approximately 142 million yen, operating profit of 5.4 million yen, and positive net assets of 2.7 million yen, having recovered from losses in prior years.

The acquisition was previously announced on September 4, 2026. Before the acquisition, Makaluru Digital was held by four individual shareholders: Takuro Hisikawa (40%), Takahiro Usami (20%), Sho Suwa (20%), and Tao Sasaki (20%). The company had no prior capital, personnel, or business relationships with Forside.

Forside stated that it is currently assessing the impact of this acquisition on the consolidated results for the current fiscal period and will promptly disclose any necessary revisions to earnings forecasts or other material information as circumstances warrant.
